list: The official 55 trophies as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 November 2026. Names and descriptions are PlayStation's own words; every guide below is written for this page, in its own words, and cites its sources.

trophies.guide: There is nothing to hunt directly here: this pops the moment the other 54 are done. Treat the Roadmap tab as the plan — story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole run about 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10, in a single playthrough with no online trophies.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Finish the story and all side strands (Stage 1).
Clear the 100% checklist (Stage 2).
Mop up the remaining activities and collectibles (Stage 3).

trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and the trophy pops when it ends. It cannot be missed — it is the first mission of the story — and it doubles as your introduction to fishing, which matters later when you take on Cal for Baited My Tackle.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start the story and follow the opening mission to its end.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Before you leave the chapter, do the one thing that can never be repeated: the first meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). PowerPyx flags that single meditation as the only possibly missable moment in the whole list, so get it done while Chapter 1 is still open.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play Chapter 1 through to its final mission.
Before the chapter ends, do the Jason's house meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Once you pass the Coffee Break mission, Jason and Lucia are both playable, which opens the last meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude — so the chapter that looks like pure story also unlocks the end of the missable trophy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play Chapter 2 through to its final mission.
After Coffee Break, both characters are playable — remember that for the last meditation spot.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it pops on its own as you play, and nothing in this chapter can lock you out of the platinum — keep taking optional missions as they appear, since several trophy strands start that way.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play Chapter 3 through to its final mission.
Take optional missions as they appear; they feed the side strands.

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in this chapter, which is what Maximum Withdrawal is built on — so if a bank-job mission appears, take it rather than leaving it for later.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play Chapter 4 through to its final mission.
Take the optional mission that opens bank jobs.

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission and this gold pops. There is no mission replay, so make a manual save before the finale — KeenGamer recommends a save at the start and end of every chapter — in case you want to revisit anything about the ending. After the credits, free-roam continues and everything the platinum still needs stays open.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.
Continue in free-roam for the Stage 2 cleanup.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies like this one pop when the mission ends, whatever approach you take — there are no gold-medal requirements on missions, so play it however suits you.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Breakfast Run story mission to its end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a story beat, not a side robbery: it pops when the mission ends, and the bank-vault practice it gives you feeds straight into Maximum Withdrawal later.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play The Cartel Heist story mission to its end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like every named-mission trophy, it is unmissable as long as you keep playing the story — it pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the Child's Play story mission to its end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The trophy name is the mission's own shorthand, and it pops when the mission ends — no special approach needed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the Headliners story mission to its end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The airport comes back into play for Catch Me If You Can, so the layout you learn here is worth remembering.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the VCIA Takedown story mission to its end.

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is the last of the named-mission trophies: once it pops, the remaining story trophies are just the chapter and finale ones.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the Operation Savage Glory story mission to its end.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the list and the whole second stage of the roadmap. Open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the checklist — progress made before the story ends already counts, and nothing on it is missable. KeenGamer's breakdown of the checklist: all robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 100 optional tasks, and the collectible lines (15 complete card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries). PowerPyx puts this stage at about 100 hours, most of the 200-hour platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first — checklist progress already counts.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list top to bottom.
Clear every robbery line, then the collectibles, then the challenges.

trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count, and Sixshore counts 397 stunts across Leonida in total — so you do not need to find them all, just 250. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so pushing past this trophy's 250 toward 300 kills two birds with one stone.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Attempt stunts whenever you travel — jumps, bridge flights, base jumps.
Reach 250 for this trophy, then keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once — one attempt each is enough, you do not need to win or finish anything. Sixshore lists fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool and basketball among the nine, with arcade games among the rest. Sample them as they unlock during Stage 1 and this pops early.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball and the arcade as each unlocks.
One try of the ninth type pops the trophy.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a pure skill grind: learn each range's target pattern, take your time on the first run to learn it, then go for gold. Ranges stay open after the story, so there is no rush — leave it for Stage 2 and work through the ranges one at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and learn its challenge pattern.
Gold all 42 challenges, range by range.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at every one rather than 14 wins anywhere. Learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race to win — the drone handles the same everywhere, so the course knowledge is what improves.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win a race at each of the 14 locations.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the word different is the whole trophy, so 20 wins on the same circuit count as one. Work through the race list across Leonida, one new race at a time, and tick each off here as you win it. Street, off-road and water races all count toward the 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Open the race list and pick a race you have not won yet.
Win 20 distinct races.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing rival you meet through the story's fishing missions — the opening mission Gone Fishing teaches you the mechanics. Challenge him once you are confident with casting and reeling, and the trophy pops on the win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Learn fishing in the opening missions.
Take Cal's fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish — any cabinet, any game. It counts as one of the nine activity types for Master of None too, so play it the first time you pass an arcade and let both trophies move at once.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one game through to its end.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, and PowerPyx notes that trophy-related quest givers who go temporarily unavailable during the story all come back later — so if Andy vanishes for a stretch, keep playing the story and he returns. The strand can be finished after the story in free-roam.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Follow Andy's missions as Lucia.
Complete his final mission — after the story if needed.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Like the other character strands, it is a chain of missions for one quest giver, and the final one pops the trophy. If Kenton is temporarily unavailable mid-story, he comes back — every trophy-related quest giver does, per PowerPyx.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Follow Kenton's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Billy's strand is a self-contained chain: take each mission as it appears and the trophy pops at the end of the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Follow Billy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands — full chains, not single missions. Sixshore notes PowerPyx is still confirming exactly which side questlines count, and that the strands can be finished after the story, so save this for Stage 3: finish the character strands first (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret), then count how many stranger strands you have and top up with the remaining ones.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish the named character strands first.
Take stranger missions (black icons) across Leonida.
Complete 8 full strands — check your count here as you go.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Randy's chain is one of the five named character strands with its own trophy — work through his missions as they appear and the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Follow Randy's missions as they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as Jason, and — like Andy's — it can be finished after the story if the missions dry up mid-game. The trophy pops at the end of his final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Follow Tyrone's missions as Jason.
Complete his final mission — after the story if needed.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The only trophy in the list that can be missed, and the one this guide is built around. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia. The first meditation is the trap: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia is in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning and says she is going to meditate — follow her to the balcony, choose Accept, and she teaches you. It is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and it is still unclear whether it is required, so PowerPyx says do it anyway. The last spot needs both characters playable, which opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Two safety nets if you already passed Chapter 1: the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed first meditation cannot cost you A Long Road — but this trophy itself may be gone, so do it in Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — the first meditation.
After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), both characters are playable: meditate at the remaining spots.
Work through all 18 spots across the 10 locations.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is Jason-only, and the hunt is a single tracked target rather than general hunting — follow Bret's missions until the unique animal is marked, then take it down as instructed. It also counts toward the hunting activity type for Master of None.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Follow Bret's missions as Jason.
Hunt the unique animal he marks for you.

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — out of 18 sets in total, per Sixshore, so you only need the three easiest. Cards are scattered across Leonida; pick up every card you pass during Stage 1, and in Stage 2 chase the three sets closest to completion. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this trophy is a milestone on the way to a much longer hunt.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up every collectible card you pass during the story.
In Stage 2, finish the three sets closest to completion.

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app at 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, per Sixshore. The habit to build in Stage 1 is to open WAiNK at every new place you visit — the counter climbs passively while you play, and the 100% checklist wants all 100 anyway, so this trophy and the checklist are the same job.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app at every landmark, curiosity and sculpture you pass.
Reach 100 WAiNK locations — the same 100 the 100% checklist wants.

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. The game has 80 challenges in eight groups of ten, per PowerPyx (via GTASpotter), so you need 50 of 80 — pick the groups that suit how you play and leave the rest. PowerPyx's Stage 2 aims for 70 of the 80 as part of the 100% push, so this trophy pops well before the checklist is done.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open the challenges list and pick a group that suits your playstyle.
Complete 50 challenges across the groups.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Build the heat together — four stars means the law is properly after you — then break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner beside you is the whole trophy: the same escape solo counts for nothing.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Get your partner with you and raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and escape the search area until the stars clear.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your wanted level between them. The trick is the route: pick three shops close together, hit them in quick succession, and keep the wanted level alive — if it drops to zero the chain breaks and you start over. Fast driving between stops matters more than the robberies themselves.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route.
Rob all three in succession with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. KeenGamer's Stage 1 advice is to scan unfamiliar vehicles with the WAiNK app as you travel — that discovery habit is what fills this counter. Every new model you scan counts, so vary your routes and scan anything you have not seen before instead of driving the same car all game.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan every unfamiliar vehicle with WAiNK as you travel.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up rather than hoping for it: gather a group of enemies first — a gang shootout or a wanted-level fight works — then trigger Combat Focus and drop five before it ends. Five in one use is the count; four does not count.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down five before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: take an aircraft and leave the airport without a scheduled flight. The airport layout from the VCIA Takedown mission helps — get to a plane, get airborne, and the trophy pops on departure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and get to an aircraft.
Take off without a scheduled flight.

trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction — it names the Rhino tank and nothing else. Early reports point to the Rhino tanks the law brings out at high wanted levels: get the heat up until Rhinos deploy, then deal with them. The exact trigger is still being pinned down by the guide sites, so check the in-game hint if it does not pop at first contact.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Raise a high wanted level until Rhino tanks deploy.
Take on the Rhinos as the description hints.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, no cameras catching you. Plan the entry, take what you need, and leave before anyone knows you were there — a loud robbery of the same store does not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it and leave with nobody detecting you.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs open through an optional mission in Chapter 4, and Sixshore counts eight vaults in total — you need five for this trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all eight, so keep going past five. The escape is part of the trophy: losing the heat after each vault is what banks it.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Take the optional Chapter 4 mission that opens bank jobs.
Rob five bank vaults, escaping after each.
Keep going to all eight for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find one on the road, stop it, crack it open, take the cash and lose the heat — the escape is part of the trophy, just as it is for the bank vaults. Trucks run regular routes, so watch the roads and hit one when it is isolated.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it, rob it, and escape.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named area on the map. The counter is the map itself: travel the state methodically, through Vice City, the beaches, the swamps and the small towns, and the grey areas fill in. It pairs naturally with the WAiNK and vehicle-discovery hunts, so do them on the same trips.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through every named area of Leonida.
Check the map for grey areas you have not visited yet.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — one per gang, across all of Leonida's gangs. Gang operations are the same targets the 100% checklist counts (39 of them), so work through them gang by gang and this trophy pops when the last gang's operation is hit.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find illegal operations on the map.
Rob one operation for each gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a cocktail, and take it in with the ocean in front of you — the view is the requirement, not just the drink, so sit where the beach is visible. A quiet moment in the middle of a 200-hour hunt.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail with the ocean view in front of you.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the front. It is a deliberate homage to the series' classic moments, so pick a showroom, get a car inside or lined up at the glass, and floor it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive a car through its glass front and out.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a game of bowling there. It is one of the nine activity types for Master of None as well, so a single visit can move both trophies. The name is a nod to the series' past; the alley is the place, the game is the trophy.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling through to the end.

trophies.guide: The description is deliberately vague: a partnership with mass appeal. Early reports tie it to building Jason and Lucia's public following as a duo — the social side of the partnership — but the guide sites list the precise trigger as still being confirmed. Work on the duo's public-facing activities and check the in-game progress hints; this guide will not invent a method the sources have not confirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Build the duo's public appeal through partner activities.
Check the in-game hints for what counts toward it.

trophies.guide: Make choices — for better or worse. The game counts the decisions you make through the story and side content, and this trophy pops once you have made enough of them. There is nothing to hunt: just keep deciding instead of avoiding choice prompts, and it arrives on its own during a normal playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Keep making story and side-content choices as they come.
It pops once your choice count is high enough.

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm: fail at something, then succeed on the second attempt. The wording points at succeeding right after a failure — retry the same attempt-based activity (a challenge, a race, a stunt) immediately after failing it and win the second time. It pops on the retry, not on a first-time success.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail an attempt-based activity.
Retry it at once and succeed on the second attempt.

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description reads like someone who has just seen the impossible. The guide sites list the precise trigger as still being confirmed, and the likely shape is one of the game's odd world events (the sort of UFO-style easter egg the series is known for). Explore Leonida's strange corners in Stage 3 and keep an eye out; this guide will not invent a location the sources have not confirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's unusual places in Stage 3.
Trigger and witness the strange event when you find it.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: strike someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass, swing as you go by, and the trophy pops on the hit. It is a trick shot, not a fight — one clean pass is all it takes.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a vehicle and a melee weapon ready.
Drive past a target and land a melee hit from the moving vehicle.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — vaults, trucks and gang operations — and your contacts turn them into clean money over time. It is cumulative across the whole game, so every robbery feeds it; keep laundering as you go and it pops well before you finish the robbery lines.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Rob vaults, trucks and gang operations to collect Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — cumulative, and every shop counts. Weapons, clothes, food, car mods: it all adds up over a normal playthrough, so you will likely be most of the way there by Stage 2 without trying. If you are short at the end, buy the big-ticket items you actually want rather than junk.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across shops as you play — weapons, clothes, mods.
Top up with big purchases if you are short at the end.

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property listed for sale across Leonida. Garages are the properties that store your vehicle collection, and each one you buy counts — check the property listings as you travel and buy them as you can afford them. It pairs with the vehicle hunts: a full garage is where a full collection lives.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Check property listings for garages as you travel.
Buy every garage property on the market.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find or buy vehicles, then register each one in the app — ten registrations pops the trophy. It is the small-scale cousin of Whip It Good: discover vehicles with WAiNK, then register the ones you keep.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Find or buy vehicles you want to keep.
Register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app.
